title: Cross-Border Payment Transparency & D+0 Finality Comparator
description: Compares settlement transparency and finality across 11 major cross-border rails. G20/FSB 2027 target alignment: cost <1%, speed <1hr. Outputs finality comparison table, G20 compliance scorecard, and AP2 JSON rail policy. Client-side. Zero PII.
